records.title: Flyover at 8 BS Level Crossing Gate, Ramnagar, Silchar
details:
(a) to (c) Level Crossing No. 8 BS falls on the existing NH-37 city portion in
Silchar town between Rongpur and Inter-State Bus Terminus (ISBT), for
which preparation of Detailed Project Report (DPR) has been taken up for
construction of Road Over Bridge (ROB).
